sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Bendonner is an Irish folk figure. This Scottish giant terrorized the coast of Ulster. The residents asked the giant Finn MacCOOL for help. Finn Mac Cool is a folk form of the hero Fionn Mac Cumhaill. Finn challenged Bendonner, then dressed in swaddling clothes. He posed as an enormous baby in an immense cradle. Bendonner saw the baby, feared its strength, and fled. He never troubled the coastal people again.

okr.objective: Bendonner is a giant whose terror of the Ulster coast ends when Finn Mac Cool tricks him with a baby disguise.
